WITH store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT ss_quantity,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ss_quantity) as count_,
           AVG(ss_ext_tax + ss_net_paid_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY ss_quantity) as avg_tax_and_paid
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE  ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 OR
           ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 OR
           ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 OR
           ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 OR
           ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100
)
SELECT (CASE WHEN count_ > 1071 THEN avg_tax_and_paid ELSE NULL END ) as bucket1,
       (CASE WHEN count_ > 39161 THEN avg_tax_and_paid ELSE NULL END ) as bucket2,
       (CASE WHEN count_ > 29434 THEN avg_tax_and_paid ELSE NULL END ) as bucket3,
       (CASE WHEN count_ > 6568 THEN avg_tax_and_paid ELSE NULL END ) as bucket4,
       (CASE WHEN count_ > 21216 THEN avg_tax_and_paid ELSE NULL END ) as bucket5 
FROM reason JOIN store_sales_agg ON r_reason_sk = reason.r_reason_sk WHERE r_reason_sk = 1
